questions.stem: Which service is a managed relational database service that supports engines such as MySQL, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server?

options.rationale: DynamoDB is a NoSQL key-value and document database.
ElastiCache is an in-memory cache and data store, not a relational database service.
Amazon RDS sets up, operates and scales relational databases with a choice of engines.
S3 is object storage, not a relational database.

questions.explanation: The clue is relational engines such as MySQL and SQL Server: Amazon RDS runs them as a managed service, while DynamoDB and ElastiCache are non-relational.

questions.stem: Which fully managed relational database engine is compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL?

options.rationale: DynamoDB is a NoSQL database.
DocumentDB is a MongoDB-compatible document database, not a relational one.
Neptune is a graph database.
Aurora is a fully managed relational database engine that is compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL.

questions.explanation: The clue is a relational database compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL: that is Aurora, while DynamoDB, DocumentDB and Neptune are non-relational.

questions.stem: Which service is a serverless NoSQL key-value database that delivers single-digit millisecond performance at any scale?

options.rationale: DynamoDB is a serverless NoSQL database with consistent single-digit millisecond performance.
RDS for MySQL is a managed relational database.
Aurora is a relational database.
Redshift is a data warehouse.

questions.explanation: The clues are NoSQL and key-value: DynamoDB is a serverless key-value database, while RDS and Aurora are relational and Redshift is for analytics.

questions.stem: A company wants to keep frequently read data in memory so its application gets microsecond read latency. Which service fits this need?

options.rationale: Amazon RDS is a managed relational database that keeps its data on disk, not an in-memory store.
ElastiCache is a fully managed in-memory caching service with microsecond latency.
EBS is block storage for EC2, not a database.
Redshift is a data warehouse for analytics.

questions.explanation: The clue is keeping data in memory: ElastiCache is the memory-based option, while RDS is a relational database on disk and Redshift is for analytics.

questions.stem: When is it better for a company to run its database on Amazon EC2 instead of Amazon RDS?

options.text: When it wants AWS to handle patching, backups and upgrades
options.rationale: That is what Amazon RDS provides.

options.text: When it wants the least operational effort
options.rationale: A managed service is lower effort.

options.text: When it needs full control of the operating system
options.rationale: Self-managing on EC2 gives full control of the operating system and database settings, at the cost of more operational work.

options.text: When it wants AWS-managed Multi-AZ failover
options.rationale: RDS Multi-AZ provides that.

questions.explanation: Trade-off: EC2-hosted databases give control; managed databases reduce operational effort.

questions.stem: Which tool converts a database schema from one engine to another, for example from Oracle to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, before the data is migrated?

options.rationale: Application Migration Service rehosts whole servers on Amazon EC2; it does not convert a database to a new engine.
The AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) converts a database schema from one engine to another.
AWS Backup manages backups.
AWS Glue discovers, prepares and moves data for analytics; it does not convert schemas between database engines.

questions.explanation: The clue is converting the schema between different engines: AWS SCT does that, and AWS DMS then moves the data.

questions.stem: Which service is a data warehouse for running complex analytic queries across large amounts of structured data?

options.rationale: Redshift is a fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse.
DynamoDB is for key-value access at scale, not analytic queries.
ElastiCache is an in-memory cache for fast reads, not an analytics warehouse.
Neptune is a graph database.

questions.explanation: Redshift is used for analytics and reporting across large structured data sets.

questions.stem: Which Amazon RDS feature keeps a standby copy of the database in another Availability Zone and fails over to it automatically?

options.rationale: Read replicas are asynchronous copies that scale read traffic; promoting one to a standalone instance is a step you take yourself.
Multi-AZ maintains a synchronous standby in another AZ and fails over automatically.
Backups support point-in-time recovery, not instant failover.

options.text: Encryption at rest with AWS KMS
options.rationale: Encryption protects data but does not provide availability.

questions.explanation: Multi-AZ is for high availability; read replicas are for read scaling.

questions.stem: A company stores user session data as key-value pairs and needs to scale to millions of requests per second. Which type of database fits best?

options.text: A relational database such as Amazon RDS for MySQL
options.rationale: Relational databases suit structured data with joins, not key-value lookups at this scale.

options.text: A data warehouse such as Amazon Redshift
options.rationale: Data warehouses are for analytics, not high-rate transactional lookups.

options.text: A NoSQL database such as Amazon DynamoDB
options.rationale: Key-value access at very large scale is what DynamoDB is designed for.

options.text: An archive such as Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive
options.rationale: Archives are for rarely accessed data.

questions.explanation: Choose the database by data model and access pattern: relational, key-value, in-memory, graph or analytics.

questions.stem: A company plans a heterogeneous migration from an on-premises Oracle database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. Which TWO AWS tools are commonly used together for this? (Choose TWO.)

options.rationale: Application Migration Service rehosts whole servers on Amazon EC2; it does not convert a database to a new engine.
AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) migrates the data while the source database stays operational.
AWS Backup protects data but does not migrate between engines.
The AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) converts the schema from Oracle to PostgreSQL.
Athena queries data in S3.

questions.explanation: Heterogeneous migrations (different engines) use AWS SCT for the schema and AWS DMS for the data.

questions.stem: Which database service is built for highly connected data, such as recommendation engines and fraud detection?

options.rationale: Redshift is a data warehouse.
Aurora is a relational database.
Neptune is a managed graph database.
DynamoDB is a key-value and document database.

questions.explanation: Graph databases store relationships between items efficiently.

questions.stem: A company's application uses a MongoDB database. The company wants a fully managed AWS database that works with MongoDB APIs and drivers. Which service should it choose?

options.rationale: Neptune is a graph database for highly connected data.
DynamoDB is a key-value and document database with its own API, not a MongoDB-compatible one.
DocumentDB is a fully managed document database that is compatible with MongoDB APIs and drivers.
ElastiCache is an in-memory cache, not a document database.

questions.explanation: The clue is MongoDB compatibility: Amazon DocumentDB is the MongoDB-compatible document database, while DynamoDB is a NoSQL database with its own API.
